interpretation.label: sd106_below_pca32_parity

preconditions.name: instrument_rawfield_control_supra_floor
preconditions.description: The raw 25-dim resource field decoded at the consumer's width must clear RAW_FIELD_CONTROL_FLOOR, else the dataset/labels are blind and no track's reading means anything.
preconditions.control: rawfield_ceiling arm, worst seed (x1002's imported positive control)

preconditions.name: anchor_pca32_reaches_parity_bar_on_majority
preconditions.description: The PCA-32 calibration anchor must itself reach SD106_PARITY_BAR at the consumer rung on a SEED MAJORITY -- the same aggregation the acceptance criterion uses, and the one its reachability certificate proves. The anchor DEFINES parity: if it cannot clear the bar on this run, an SD-106 null is an instrument failure, not a verdict.
preconditions.control: ws250_pca at mlp128 -- a task-agnostic linear compression of the encoder's own input at the encoder's own width; 1010 measured 0.8836 / 0.8578 / 0.8702

preconditions.name: sd106_bypass_trained_off_zero
preconditions.description: SD-106's linear bypass is ZERO-INITIALISED, so a warmup that never stepped it leaves the flag enabled and the mechanism inert. The worst seed's ||W_skip|| must be strictly above zero.
preconditions.control: SD-106 ON arm's world_encoder_skip weight norm after P0, worst seed

preconditions.name: sd106_encoder_trained_in_p0
preconditions.description: The SD-106 arm's z_world path must have CHANGED during P0 -- the SD-070 / V3-EXQ-783 readiness signature. A zero weight delta means the encoder never trained, and the ON-vs-OFF delta this run reports would then be an artefact rather than an SD-106 effect.
preconditions.control: latent_stack_weight_delta n_changed on the SD-106 arm, worst seed

preconditions.name: sd106_latent_not_collapsed
preconditions.description: z_world must not have COLLAPSED under the reweighting: preservation_weight=200.0 against variance_weight=25.0 / covariance_weight=50.0. SD-070's own absolute floor (V3-EXQ-783); 1010's OFF arm measured 4.22-5.67 on these seeds.
preconditions.control: participation ratio of the SD-106 z_world, worst seed

preconditions.name: sd106_p0a_n_steps_supra_shipped
preconditions.description: the SD-106 P0a head actually took the raised optimiser-step budget -- read BACK OFF THE TRAINER as p0a_n_steps, not asserted
preconditions.control: worst (minimum) p0a_n_steps over every SD-106 cell, with a non-reporting cell scored as 0. V3-EXQ-1041 measured 396/396/348 steps at the shipped epochs=12 and 1320/1320/1160 at epochs=40, so this floor separates the two budgets by construction.

criteria.name: C2_manipulation_engaged_on_but_not_off
criteria.threshold_note: both halves must hold: the preservation head RAN on every SD-106 cell and did NOT run on any OFF cell.

criteria.name: C3_p0a_budget_raised_above_shipped
criteria.threshold_note: non-degeneracy witness for the MANIPULATION: the raised budget must have reached the trainer on EVERY SD-106 cell. Does not decide the verdict -- C1 does.

interpretation.combination_rule: C1 alone decides the verdict. C2 is a non-degeneracy witness that the manipulation actually engaged -- the preservation head ran on every SD-106 cell and on no OFF cell -- and it gates C1's own non-degeneracy rather than the verdict.

anchor_reachability.reference_source: V3-EXQ-1010 ws250_pca AT THE CONSUMER RUNG mlp128, seeds 42/43/44 (0.8836 / 0.8578 / 0.8702) -- 2 of 3 clear 0.85, which is exactly the majority the shipped gate requires and the margin it survives on. NOT the best-over-rungs series, which is a different and systematically higher statistic (red-team F1).
V3-EXQ-1041 manifest arm_results sd106__b_steps1200, seeds 42/43/44 -- the same 60-episode x 40-epoch cell this run's warmup reproduces

interpretation.null_reading: A null means the SD-106 objective at preservation_weight=200.0 does not recover oracle-relevant content on this rung -- NOT that preservation is the wrong lever. Route to /failure-autopsy, not to an automatic re-queue at another weight.

off_arm_budget.why: x1010._warm_off_agent passes no zworld_p0_config, so the OFF track trains at ZWorldP0Config's default epochs=12 -- the SHIPPED budget. The OFF track is a shipped-budget REFERENCE reproducing V3-EXQ-1023's own OFF numbers at the same seeds, NOT a budget-matched control.
off_arm_budget.consequence: every ON-minus-OFF quantity in this manifest confounds the preservation term with 3.3x more Adam steps. Those deltas are CONTEXT ONLY. Nothing routes on them: C1 is an absolute bar against a budget-independent PCA-32 anchor, and both pre-registered discrimination predictions are agreement LEVELS, not deltas.
off_arm_budget.successor_note: a budget-matched consumer-rung contrast needs an OFF@40 track, which is a new arm and therefore a successor letter, not this run's one-config-knob routing.

diverged_cells.why: x1010._best_over_rungs applies no diverged filter. EXCLUDING would change the instrument the acceptance target names as unchanged and break comparability with V3-EXQ-1023/1010. The load-bearing criterion C1 reads the CONSUMER RUNG cell directly (x1010._cell), never _best_over_rungs, so the hazard cannot touch the verdict; best-over-rungs figures are context only.

discrimination.routed_on: NOTHING. The verdict is decided by C1 against the pre-set acceptance bar alone. These predictions are recorded so /failure-autopsy can read the outcome as a discrimination without this run inventing a second threshold governance never set. Both predictions sit BELOW the 0.85 bar, so a FAIL here is an informative discrimination, not a null.
discrimination.registry_note: both legs are EXISTING legs on the EXISTING question; this run opens no leg and edits no registry file.

prior_evidence_context.in_training_holdout_r2_note: sd106_preservation_holdout_r2 recorded by this run is a jointly-SGD-trained head's own holdout metric and is a LOWER BOUND on linear-decodable content; it is NOT this run's DV. The post-hoc OLS probe that reads the same code higher is V3-EXQ-1041's separate instrument and is cited, not recomputed here.
prior_evidence_context.design_doc_anchor_not_comparable: the SD-106 design doc's 0.9974/0.9978 obs R^2 table is on a DIFFERENT observation distribution; it is not comparable to any P0a acceptance number.

decomposition_is_order_dependent.order_symmetric: no_dominant_explanation -- metric 0.404 / budget 0.475 / residual 0.104, leader margin below the pre-registered 0.15 on 3/3 seeds
